summary: Advanced system architecture by integrating PEP 487-based plugin registries and robust observability, while simultaneously optimizing the internal knowledge base through a new semantic deduplication engine. These efforts enforce strict API contracts, ensure asynchronous state integrity, and maintain high-signal memory efficiency to support verifiable self-modification and the 1% growth metric.
key_learnings: PEP 487 provides robust, boilerplate-free plugin management for safe, verifiable self-modification.
Structured observability and fail-fast design are critical for maintaining asynchronous workflow integrity.
Semantic deduplication using high-threshold similarity checks (0.85+) effectively maintains high-signal memory without feature-creep.
Prioritizing architectural integrity over immediate infrastructure tasks preserves a minimal, high-performance agent footprint.
